changes: Replaced the main menu and duplicate quick-edit routes with a section-ordered list and focused editor.
Search indexes parent items, individual options, hidden source records, multilingual text and IDs. Searches reset limiting section/status filters.
One item panel contains photo replacement/removal, name, price, description, translations, visibility and menu labels.
Stable option identity links parent/child edits. Changes commit in one IndexedDB transaction; failed saves leave the draft intact.
Options can be added, removed or reordered. Hidden source items can be restored to their parent options. Section/order management stays collapsed until needed.
Room studio combines a cover photo, collapsible gallery controls, details, amenities and tariffs. Form drafts survive gallery re-renders.
Room metadata is now included in publishing and applied to guest room cards, enquiries and tariff displays. Existing untouched room presentations retain their original layout.
Guest search, Collections and favourites are inside one compact bottom Menu tools drawer. Collections keeps the full menu available and scrolls below the header.
Reduced duplicate Admin tabs, CRM promotions and repeated publish buttons. Menu studio opens after unlock.
